findings.title: A URL-less attachment's zero or several fallback reaches tail as `skip`, while preflight calls it a PR-half degradation
findings.recommendation: The tail's emit-reading table keys on two bits (`pr_url`, `pr_state`), but preflight's `none` and `several` outcomes and its `unobserved` and `gh-absent` outcomes all write neither field, so tail cannot tell them apart. Preflight's own table says `none`/`several` are `proceed` with `degraded: "pr"` (commit and push stand); tail's row 'neither, with an attachment' says `skip`. The delta contradicts itself, and D-rc12-9's DERIVED closure missed a member. The emit cannot carry the distinction without a new field.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Tail takes preflight's outcome on the command line (`--outcome <code>`, from preflight's record), the body passing it through; the emit stays the record of pr_url/pr_state, and tail's table keys on the outcome. No emit-shape change; the handoff is explicit.

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Add an optional `pr_outcome` field to the archive emit (orbit-emit-composition, a second capability), and key tail's table on it.

recommendation_options.label: C
recommendation_options.body: Read the owner's zero/several rule as a whole-tail SKIP (its text says 'SKIP with a note' there, unlike the validation paragraph's explicit commit-and-push), change preflight's none/several rows to `skip`, and tail's table stays as written.

findings.title: Retiring `config --get` leaves no allowlisted read of a GitHub-shaped remote URL in the harness the walk prescribes
findings.recommendation: Measured: a bare remote reached through `url.<path>.insteadOf https://github.com/acme/widget.git` pushes and fetches, but `git remote get-url origin` (allowlisted) and `git ls-remote --get-url` both return the rewritten local path; only `git config --get remote.origin.url` returns the GitHub URL. A GitHub URL without the rewrite cannot be fetched at all. So the canonical-id derivation fails in every harness case unless the engine reads the raw URL. Restore `config --get remote.<r>.url` (exactly that key) to the allowlist, state that the canonical id derives from the configured URL, and name the insteadOf rewrite as the harness mechanism. That also matches users whose real checkouts carry insteadOf rewrites.

findings.recommendation: The D-rc12-8..14 capture was the exploration session's edit (commit d9116cb5), before the walk, and every entry lists explore.md under `kept` only. A record gap by construction of the redesign route, not a defect.

commentary: Sixteen of nineteen entries landed: the record split, the select inputs table, the bounded fetch, the URL-bearing record rule, publish's two segments and the closed preflight set all read as the walks claimed. The two regressions share a cause: each resolution changed an input domain without re-running every member of it. The tail table was derived from two emit fields and never checked against preflight's seven outcomes, and the ghurl retirement was written without trying to fetch from a GitHub-shaped remote. The second was settled by running it; the first by reading the two tables side by side.
